title: Codentry Finding
description: The normalized shape every static-analysis or AI finding must conform to before being stored or posted to a PR. Source of truth for both the Python (services/ai-review) and TypeScript (apps/web) sides. Introduced in Phase 1 as a documented contract only; first consumed by code in Phase 3 (services/ai-review/analysis/finding.py, static findings) and Phase 4 (AI findings). The `file` field was renamed to `file_path` in Phase 3 to match the database schema — this schema had no code consumer yet, so the rename was free.

source.description: Which layer produced this finding. Required so every finding is independently attributable (PRD FR-4).

confidence.description: Required for AI findings (PRD FR-5). Always null for ESLINT/SEMGREP findings, which have no notion of confidence.

suggestion.description: Prose only, never a diff/patch — Codentry never auto-applies a fix.

reasoning.description: AI findings only. Short explanation of why the model flagged this.

evidence_span.description: AI findings only. The exact code text the finding refers to, cross-checked against the real file content at start_line-end_line as a hallucination guard (Phase 4).

dedup_hash.description: Deterministic hash of (source, file_path, start_line, end_line, rule_id) — see services/ai-review/analysis/finding.py:compute_dedup_hash. Never derived from a timestamp or random value.
